تبحوا (form I)
# تَبَحُّوا (tabaḥḥū) /ta.baħ.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of بَحَّ (baḥḥa)
# تُبَحُّوا (tubaḥḥū) /tu.baħ.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of بَحَّ (baḥḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
